**Asia pre-market reactions — 2026-09-29 (Tue)**

**TL;DR**

- All 4 Asian markets closed modestly lower.
- **Nikkei -0.60%**, **TWSE -0.82%**, **HSI -0.48%**, **KOSPI -0.28%** (KOSPI holding up best on a Goldman "Korea AI-stock selloff has gone too far, doubles down on bull case" note).
- Dominant macro theme: **rising bond yields + oil + AI uncertainty** ("Oil Bills, Bond Yields, Tech Jitters Damp Asian Stock Markets").
- AI infrastructure debt-cost worries after OpenAI's $30B / $1.4T-valuation funding round.
- Biggest single-name move: **MediaTek 2454.TW -7.10%** on AI-chip risk-off.

- Mean-reversion day: SK Innovation (-7.78% vs Tue +6.03%), LG Chem (-4.76% vs Tue +3.96%), Nidec (-3.85% vs Mon -17.61% — still bleeding from $6.3B impairment).
- Sector signal: **HK property bid** — Sunac +8.66%, Country Garden +6.74%, China Overseas +3.72%, China Resources Land +3.39% on China property rebound.
